tagline: Documentation metadata for WebC components, from the comments already in the file
lede: webcdoc reads a .webc file and writes one JSON record for the component: its props, slots, CSS custom properties, parts, and the page data it reads. The docs live in WebC's own server-only comments, so nothing ships to the page.

usage.caption: eleventy.config.js

features.title: Reads the comments you already write
features.description: Server-only WebC comments carry the summary, props, slots, CSS hooks, and examples. Nothing extra ships to the page.

features.title: Knows what the host provides
features.description: Inside Eleventy, the plugin collects the filters and helpers your site registers, so a call to one of them is documented as a host helper.

features.title: Checks the output
features.description: A JSON Schema and a linter turn the warnings into findings you can fail a build on.
